objective: FastAPI validates, profiles and analyses a valid CSV with the documented contract; engine mean cross-checked independently

objective: Invalid inputs are rejected with the defined validation responses at both service boundaries
preconditions: Analytics up; invalid input files in evidence/system/inputs
steps: FastAPI: header-only, empty, missing token, duplicate headers; Laravel: duplicate-header CSV validate, .txt upload
expected: FastAPI: valid=false with NO_DATA_ROWS; ANALYTICS_INVALID_DATASET; 401 without token; EMPTY_COLUMN_NAME+DUPLICATE_COLUMN. Laravel: 422 CSV_VALIDATION_FAILED; 422 for .txt

objective: Backend returns a controlled error when the analytics service is down and recovers after restart without false success
preconditions: Analysis UPLOADED; local analytics container stopped (failure injection on dev stack)
steps: docker compose stop analytics; POST validate; GET analysis; docker compose start analytics; wait /health; POST validate
expected: 5xx with error code ANALYTICS_UNAVAILABLE; status stays UPLOADED; after restart validate returns 200
actual: during outage HTTP 503 code=ANALYTICS_UNAVAILABLE msg='The analytics service is unavailable.'; status after=UPLOADED; healthy after restart=True; retry HTTP 200

objective: Repeated processing does not duplicate or corrupt results
preconditions: Fresh DEFINED analysis with the golden CSV
steps: POST /run twice with one Idempotency-Key; wait; re-upload the same file (the transient copy is purged after a run); profile; run again; compare evidence keys
expected: Second call replayed (Idempotent-Replayed: true); both runs ANALYZED; evidence counts equal distinct counts; identical key sets across runs
actual: run 202/202 replayed=true; run1 ANALYZED 75|75; reupload 201; run2 ANALYZED 75|75; identical key sets=True
